comparison.objective: Screen ceramic finishing media from retained washers, versus opening a crown-capped bottle with a mounted opener.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pouring, screen support, agitation and granular separation versus positioning a bottle under a fixed tooth and levering off its cap.
comparison.success_condition: Media recovery, washer retention, zero spill and released screen dwell versus cap removal and upright bottle placement on a coaster.
comparison.reason: The record tests fixed-tool cap levering, not selective particle passage through a manipulated screen.
